summary: America Great Health filed an 8-K to disclose preliminary results of a small clinical observation study of ion-modified peptide products (AX-3, PPY-3) conducted at Zhejiang Kangjing Hospital in China (Dec 2024-May 2026) in ten subjects, mostly with advanced solid tumors. The study was observational, adjunctive, and not randomized/controlled. Outcomes varied; two subjects died. No significant treatment-related toxicity was reported. This is a routine business update on clinical data, not a special-situation event. No transaction, tender, activism, restructuring, or management change is involved. Investors should watch for further regulatory or clinical announcements, but no risk-arb angle applies.
